description: Assembles a request for a person to review: who, which agreement, and an idempotency key. It does not send anything. Sending is a separate, authenticated, human-confirmed step owned by Console, and it is disabled on this site. Use it only when the person asks for terms. Pass personAsked: true to confirm they asked. The call is refused without it. Do not offer terms unprompted. Name and email are accepted only after the person agrees to share them. Pass consent: true only once they have agreed. The call is refused without it. The only personal details it collects are the person's name and email. Collected: name, email. Privacy policy: https://thebitcoinadviser.com/privacy-policy. While sending is disabled, the person takes the request to the team themselves, through the Contact page in nextStep. They can read the terms first at readableTermsUrl.
name: prepare_terms_request
title: Prepare a terms request
